purpose: Permit a provisional reference orientation under explicit partial classification without coercing undefined orientations to FALSE.

constraints: Omega_x_pos, Omega_x_neg, and Omega_x_undef are pairwise disjoint.
Every membership classification retains its AdmObs_x provenance.

Resolution_x.meaning: A total completion of the partial AdmObs_x classification.

PermittedResolution_x.signature: PermittedResolution_x(P_x, rho_x; B_x, D_rel, R) : Prop
conditions: rho_x(o)=TRUE for every o in Omega_x_pos.
rho_x(o)=FALSE for every o in Omega_x_neg.
rho_x assigns only TRUE or FALSE to every o in Omega_x_undef.
Assignments to Omega_x_undef satisfy pointwise admissibility under the declared domain, boundary, and residue constraints.
The jointly assigned orientation family satisfies GlobalJointCoherence_x(rho_x; B_x, D_rel, R).
rho_x does not revise an established positive or negative classification.

RefDetermines_x.signature: RefDetermines_x(RefRule_x, rho_x, o_x; B_x, D_rel, R) : Prop
RefDetermines_x.policy: The strong form is required when downstream output is one reference orientation rather than a set of possible reference orientations.

resolution_space: Res_x(P_x; B_x, D_rel, R) := {rho_x | PermittedResolution_x(P_x, rho_x; B_x, D_rel, R)}

resolution_requirements.pointwise: Every unresolved orientation receives a binary value satisfying PointwiseResolutionCompatible_x.
resolution_requirements.joint: The completed family satisfies GlobalJointCoherence_x across all jointly assigned orientations.
resolution_requirements.boundary: The completion remains compatible with B_x.
resolution_requirements.residue: The completion remains compatible with R.
resolution_requirements.totality: Every rho_x in Res_x is total over Omega_obs.

PointwiseResolutionCompatible_x.signature: PointwiseResolutionCompatible_x(o, rho_x; P_x, B_x, D_rel, R) : Prop
PointwiseResolutionCompatible_x.definition: For o in Omega_x_pos, rho_x(o)=TRUE; for o in Omega_x_neg, rho_x(o)=FALSE; for o in Omega_x_undef, rho_x(o) is binary and satisfies the declared boundary, domain, and residue compatibility conditions.
guards: It does not revise a defined TRUE or FALSE classification.
It does not treat UNDEFINED as FALSE.
It is evaluated before RefOrient and ProjectBounded.

GlobalJointCoherence_x.signature: GlobalJointCoherence_x(rho_x; P_x, B_x, D_rel, R) : Prop
GlobalJointCoherence_x.definition: The complete binary assignment rho_x is jointly realizable under the declared boundary interaction, relational domain, residue, and family-level orientation compatibility constraint JointlyCompatible_x.
required_conditions: JointlyCompatible_x(rho_x; P_x, B_x, D_rel, R) holds.
The completed family remains compatible with B_x, D_rel, and R.
No jointly impossible family is admitted merely because each member passes pointwise evaluation.

JointlyCompatible_x.signature: JointlyCompatible_x(rho_x; P_x, B_x, D_rel, R) : Prop
JointlyCompatible_x.definition: A family-level constraint asserting that the complete orientation assignment rho_x can coexist as one admissible orientation family under B_x, D_rel, and R.
JointlyCompatible_x.role: Primary cross-orientation compatibility relation used by GlobalJointCoherence_x.
JointlyCompatible_x.pairwise_guard: A pairwise relation may be a necessary subcondition, but pairwise compatibility alone is not assumed sufficient for joint compatibility.

revised_signature: PartialSufficiencyWitness_x(P_x, B_x, D_rel, R, RefRule_x, o_x) : Prop
revised_definition: PartialSufficiencyWitness_x holds iff P_x.Omega_x_undef is nonempty, o_x is in P_x.Omega_x_pos, admissibility provenance for o_x is present, Res_x(P_x; B_x, D_rel, R) is nonempty, and every rho_x in that resolution space satisfies RefDetermines_x(RefRule_x, rho_x, o_x; B_x, D_rel, R).
redundancy_correction: Preservation of AdmObs_x(o_x)=TRUE is required by construction because permitted resolutions cannot revise Omega_x_pos; the nontrivial test is reference-determining invariance across resolutions.

ref_orient_policy.uniqueness_guard: No global uniqueness claim is established unless RefRule_x is deterministic and the strong invariance condition is proved.

conditional_evaluation.statement: A provisional RefOrient output may enter delta_a evaluation as a tagged conditional candidate.

positive_realized_admission.statement: PartialSufficiencyWitness_x alone cannot produce a realized positive delta_a admission.

closure_routes.condition: Omega_x_undef becomes empty and total classification confirms the reference result.
A separate witness proves the same continuation satisfies Gamma_E, Gamma_R, Gamma_T, and Gamma_O and remains realization-admissible under every permitted resolution of Omega_x_undef.

delta_a_policy.future_entry_condition: Total resolution is sufficient but not necessary; either totality or full-continuation realization invariance may close the conditional candidate.

realization_invariance_candidate.name: ResolutionInvariantAdmission_x
realization_invariance_candidate.signature: ResolutionInvariantAdmission_x(q, P_x, B_x, D_rel, R, RefRule_x) : Prop
realization_invariance_candidate.definition: For every permitted resolution rho_x of P_x, q retains the same reference orientation and satisfies Gamma_E(q), Gamma_R(q), Gamma_T(q), and Gamma_O(q, rho_x).
realization_invariance_candidate.effect: Permits conversion from PARTIAL_REFERENCE_CONDITIONAL to a realized positive delta_a admission without requiring explicit classification of every unresolved orientation.

preserved_guards: Undefined is neither TRUE nor FALSE.
Undefined orientations are never silently discarded.
The witness does not establish total classification or total orientation exclusion.
The witness does not require completed [Asym]_x or <S>_x.
The witness is evaluated before ProjectBounded.
No empty or unresolved family is interpreted as symmetry annihilation.
next_formalization: Specify the admissible family structure and test whether JointlyCompatible_x requires higher-order constraints beyond pairwise compatibility.
